title: JavaScript Patterns
description: Level up beyond the basics: destructuring and composed pipelines, closures and higher-order functions, promises and async/await, classes with private state, immutable updates, and lazy iteration with generators, plus error-handling patterns, event emitters, strategies with dependency injection, and pipe/compose utilities.
outcomes: Pull values out of objects and arrays with destructuring
Write functions that accept a variable number of arguments
Compose filter, sort, and map into readable pipelines
Use closures for private state, memoization, once, and debounce
Predict event-loop ordering and choose between sequential awaits, Promise.all, allSettled, race, and any
Design retry with exponential backoff and test it deterministically
Encapsulate state in classes with private fields, getters, and validated methods
Write pure reducers with structural sharing and normalize nested API data
Build custom iterables and lazy generator pipelines
Model failures with custom error classes, error causes, and result objects
Implement an event emitter with on, off, once, and snapshot-safe emit
Replace branching with strategy tables and inject dependencies through plain functions
Build readable data pipelines with pipe, compose, and partial application
